rows.grounds: compound locative indicating the medium of inscription
sacred diagram as object of inscription

items.question: What medium and substances are prescribed for inscribing the sacred diagram?
premises: The sacred diagram is to be inscribed.
Birch-bark serves as the medium for inscription.
Saffron and musk serve as the substances for inscription.
items.inference: The sacred diagram should be inscribed on birch-bark using saffron and musk.
uncertainties: madena may denote musk or another ritual substance depending on tradition.
items.plain_english: One should draw the yantra on birch-bark with saffron and musk.
